title: Lattice Advisory — pilot angle sketch
content:
Quick notes + leash for Lattice Advisory outreach — high-level hypothesis:

Background:
- Mid-size wealth management / advisory firm (~350 employees). Heavy regulatory posture (FINRA + state regs).
- Recent exec hire for digital transformation (VP Product: Marco Reyes, LinkedIn note in 2023).
- They run a mix of cloud + colo (AWS + private datacenter in VA) — plausible candidate for Redwood Private or Dedicated.
- Use cases surfaced: client Q&A chatbot, document summarization for regulatory filings, portfolio-rebalancing insights (semi-structured outputs).

Signals that matter for our pitch:
- Compliance/controls > model novelty; will prefer private control plane + audit logs.
- Latency in advisor UI matters (live Q&A during calls) but throughput modest.
- Cost: evidence of high token volumes during quarter-ends when reports are generated — opportunity for batching + caching to cut spend.

Primary thesis for pilot:
- Run a small private deployment (single-customer VPC) for client Q&A + filing summarization.
- Focus success metrics: latency p95 < 300ms for short queries, cost per 1k tokens reduced 30% vs current managed provider, and accuracy/noise regression measured via 200 prompt eval suite.
- Offer 6‑8 week pilot: setup + ingestion (2 wks), live validation w/ advisors (3 wks), evaluation & handoff (1‑3 wks).

Key stakeholders (mapping):
- Marco Reyes — VP Product (DMU: prioritization + budget)
- Olivia Chen — Head of Compliance (must sign off on data flow/KMS)
- Daniel Arnett — Director of Platform (runs infra procurement)
- Suggested champion: Senior PM on digital channels (unknown) — find via Marco intro.

Initial outreach sequence (cold -> nurture):
1) Short cold email (subject options):
   - "Low-lift pilot: private LLM to speed advisor answers at lower cost"
   - "Reduce report prep costs at quarter close — 4 week pilot"
   Body (short):
   - 2 lines of problem statement + cred (Redwood inference: dedicated/private deployment + audit logs).
   - One-sentence pilot ask: 30–60 minute intro + quick architecture Q.
   - CTA: calendar link + optional one-pager.

2) Follow-up 3 days later: quick use-case note + 1pg mock architecture (VPC option + KMS). Attach sample SLA language.

3) If interest: invite to tech scoping with Daniel + SRE + product. Bring standard checklist: data residency, KMS, audit/export, throughput targets, model list.

Cold call script (30s):
- "Hi Marco, Amira from Redwood Inference — we help engineering teams run production LLMs with predictable latency and control. Quick question: how are you currently handling advisor Q&A latency and auditability around model responses?"
- If they say vendor X: "Understood — we often see teams trade off control for speed. We can spin up a private deployment behind your VPC and run a 4–6 week pilot so your compliance team can validate logs/KMS. Worth a quick 20m intro?"

Objection map (short form):
- "We already use Vendor X / OpenAI":
  - Response: "Totally. Two things we often add: 1) predictable unit economics via batching and caching so quarter-end spikes cost less; 2) private deployments with KMS + audit logs to satisfy compliance. Can we show a short ROI model?"
- "Security/compliance is a blocker":
  - Response: "Bring Olivia into the scoping call — we have documented controls, SOC2-like artifacts, and a checklist for KMS + VPC peering/air-gapped options. We can run a compliance & threat model review in week 1 of the pilot."
- "No budget / not a priority":
  - Response: "Frame as experiment: modest engineering hours + Redwood pilot credit (we can underwrite infra) — goal is to measure cost delta and risk reduction. If it doesn't move the needle, no charge."
- "No engineering bandwidth":
  - Response: "We offer professional services assistance for initial onboarding + optional managed ops for the pilot window. Can allocate an engineer to run integration work with your platform team."

Pilot scope (recommended lean):
- Goals: validate three things — compliance controls, advisor UX latency, and cost per token for heavy-batch report summarization.
- Inputs: subset of anonymized past Q&As (200–500 sessions), 5 typical report PDFs for summarization test, live traffic mirror for latency tests (non-prod).
- Deliverables: deployment diagram, audit log samples, cost delta report, quality eval (200 prompts), playbook for roll to prod.

Measurement & evaluation (what we promise):
- Quantitative: p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens (before vs after), misinfo/ hallucination rate (manual sample), # of acceptance failures vs baseline.
- Qualitative: advisor satisfaction (NPS-style quick survey), compliance sign-off checklist complete/blocked items.

Internal ask for Redwood sales/SEs:
- Jonah: lead scoping + ROI calc (template: use "quarter-end summarization" baseline).
- Priya: compliance pack + KMS runbook (quick customize).
- SE time estimate: 2–3 days for initial infra + 1 day for eval harness.

Open questions / TBD (notes to self):
- Can Lattice accept our managed private control plane or require fully customer-hosted control plane? (Check with solutions eng.)
- What are their exact retention requirements? (Olivia likely to push 7y retention for audit logs?)
- Who signs procurement? procurement contact unknown — add to discovery checklist.

Quick email templates (keep very short):
- Initial intro: "Marco — Redwood Inference here. We help teams run private LLMs behind your VPC with audit logs + measurable cost savings. Quick 20m to explore a low-effort pilot?"
- Follow-up: "Marco — Circling. Attached one-pager + example evaluation metrics. If helpful, open to underwriting infra cost for a 4–6 week pilot so your team can validate controls without budget hit."

Next steps (this doc):
- Build 1‑page pilot one-pager (Amira).
- Jonah to prepare ROI quick model by EOD Fri.
- Find Marco contact info; if no response, ask internal connections (Sales channel) for warm intro.

Scratch / raw thoughts (brain dump):
- Consider bundling our Optimize recommendations (batch+cache) as a deliverable — measurable savings are an easy hook.
- If Lattice stubborn on hosted API: propose hybrid where sensitive flows go to Private and low-risk flows stay hosted — talk up smart routing.
- Keep outreach voice advisory-first, not vendor-y. Use data: "we reduced token spend 32% for a finance firm by adding prefix caching for report generation" (figure for demo; flag as anonymized case study).

End of notes.

-- Amira (working draft)
